phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, both you and the opponent have unknown army compositions, but both are investing heavily in economy and technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more scouting information or if the opponent shows signs of an early attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, keep light defense, scout with Reaper, adapt to enemy info.
phase_policies.target: Develop economy and technology while maintaining a light defensive posture. Use Reaper for scouting to gather information about the opponent's strategy.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech and Economy Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to technology at the expense of army production or neglect scouting.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240 seconds, you have a ground-oriented army with heavy production and technology, while the opponent is still unknown but likely teching heavily.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more scouting information about the opponent's army composition or if you detect an aggressive push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, expand, maintain defense, adapt to scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while strengthening ground army. Maintain defensive posture and keep expanding.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Ground Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy without reinforcing your army, assuming the enemy is passive.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 420 seconds, you have a ground army with Marines and Medivacs, while the opponent has a ground army with Stalkers and Warp Prisms. Both have heavy economies and technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to a heavy air composition or if you face a large push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, tech up, maintain air, expand, watch for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increase technology and upgrades. Maintain air presence and consider adding more Medivacs for mobility and healing. Keep expanding.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army with Air Support
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if the opponent transitions to a heavy air composition.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, you have a ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Marauders, while the opponent has a ground army with Zealots, High Templars, Sentries, and Warp Prisms.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to a heavy air composition or if you face a large engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, tech up, maintain expansion, watch for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increase technology and upgrades. Consider adding more Siege Tanks for defensive strength and Marauders for tanking. Maintain expansion.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground Army with Siege Tanks
phase_policies.veto: Do not ignore anti-air if the opponent transitions to a heavy air composition.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
